req.title: List cookies
req.statement: The system shall respond to GET /cookies with a JSON body listing all cookies present on the request.

doc.reasoning: The view_cookies handler reads request.cookies, filters ENV_COOKIES when hide_env=True and show_env not in args, then returns jsonify(cookies=cookies). Tests must cover: (1) positive - cookies present are echoed exactly; (2) negative - no cookies yields empty dict; (3) boundary - single cookie (BVA at count=1); (4) multiple cookies (EP); (5) show_env query param disables env-cookie filtering (DT); (6) wrong HTTP method returns 405 (NEG). Key mutation targets: the 'cookies' key name in JSON, exact cookie values, status code 200, empty-dict path, and the show_env branch.

tests.name: test_get_cookies_with_single_cookie_returns_exact_value
actions: Send GET /cookies with Cookie header containing exactly one name=value pair
expected: cookies dict contains exactly the one cookie with exact value
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_get_cookies_single():
    r = client.get('/cookies', headers={'Cookie': 'session=abc123'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert 'cookies' in data
    assert data['cookies'] == {'session': 'abc123'}
    assert len(data['cookies']) == 1

test_get_cookies_single()

tests.name: test_get_cookies_multiple_cookies_all_echoed
actions: Send GET /cookies with Cookie header containing three distinct cookies
expected: JSON body cookies dict contains all three cookies with exact keys and values
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app

def test_get_cookies_multiple():
    r = client.get('/cookies', headers={'Cookie': 'a=1; b=hello; c=world'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert 'cookies' in data
    assert data['cookies'] == {'a': '1', 'b': 'hello', 'c': 'world'}
    assert len(data['cookies']) == 3
